verdict_one_line: No. After stripping job-seeker clicks, phone taps, chat opens, GA4 duplicates, Brand, PMax/DSA, and unverified WP consult forms, there is no proven golden campaign, page, or conversion to safely revive. Keep VC_* on Max Clicks to the ungated .app form.

successful_period.answer: No period is proven successful as employer leads.
successful_period.detail: USA 4967151855 spent $724,880 from 2024-08-01 to 2026-08-12 with 2,597 reported conversions vs 4,633 all-conversions. AU spent similarly inflated. The only CRM-shaped counts are Zoho JO uploads (US 67.0 / AU 36.0 in Conversions) — Zoho is incomplete, so those are uncertain, not confirmed. LK Generic VA and PMax look 'good' only if you treat Ads conversions as leads. They are not.

wordpress_leads.answer: WP received almost all paid clicks. That is not the same as generating verified employer leads.
wordpress_leads.detail: US homepage https://virtualcoworker.com/ : $395,820 / 45,876 clicks / 977.6 reported conv. Live crawl 13 Aug 2026: no form, job-seeker nav, GTM-TTKNKT, no AW- in HTML. Forms live only on /contact-us/ (Gravity Forms: first+last, email, phone, company, country, message required; US includes a Job radio). Service pages have no on-page form. 82% of historical Final URL refs were homepage or /services/* (Editor inventory 5 Aug 2026).

test_wp_now.answer: No. Do not send current VC_* traffic to WordPress.
test_wp_now.detail: WP homepage/services cannot convert on-page. Contact form has more required fields than .app, a Job option, .ph dual-door, recaptcha, and untrusted conversion twins. try.* is employer-lean but thank-you is still 404. Moving traffic would reset Stage 1 learning for a worse funnel.

recoverable_pattern.answer: Query cluster only — already live. Not a forgotten page.
recoverable_pattern.detail: Employer-intent terms (hire / Philippines / Filipino + VA) converted in Ads historically at high CPA (e.g. US 'virtual assistant philippines' $17,669 / 34.5 conv / Editor 2024-08-01–2026-08-04). Those Exact themes are already in VC_US_S_CORE / ROLES. Calendly-booked (US 373 reported) is a tracking recovery already on the conversion-plan as Secondary — not a WP revival.

old_conversions.answer: Inflated, duplicated, and often not leads. Some were expensive auctions on top of that.
old_conversions.detail: US Free Consultation Form 1,036 conv vs 1,843 all-conv, plus GA4 thank-you 788 — overlapping form tracking. Job-seeker click conversion recorded 54.0 all-conversions. AU counted Chat Opened/Started (184+164 all-conv). Zoho Zapier and Standard OCI double-count discovery and JO. eBook / UA goals / GA4 page_view & click were Primary historically. Phone clicks ≠ 60s consults.

current_problem.answer: Not a forgotten WP page. Current constraint is early Stage 1 + auction (IS) + untrusted Ads conversions.
current_problem.detail: Last 7d Search IS (13 Aug pull): US Core 31% (lost 44% budget / 25% rank); US Roles 20% (lost 65% rank / 15% budget). GA4 US ~380 paid-ish sessions / 7d; thank-you sessions are testing. Ungated .app form just went live. Max Conv was tried ~12 Aug and died — stay Max Clicks.

safest_next.answer: Leave VC_* Exact + Max Clicks on the ungated .app form. Wait 7–14 days for sales-ops confirmed employer inquiries. Do not change Final URLs.

primary.query: Existing live Exact PH/hire VA terms only
primary.rationale: Smallest credible test is to let the new form collect sales-verified inquiries on traffic you already bought. Historical WP cannot beat that on evidence.
primary.exclusions: No Broad. No Max Conv. No WP Final URL. No Brand. No Phrase enable. No PMax/DSA.
primary.budget_exposure: Current $75 Core + $50 Roles / day. Do not raise for this test.
primary.min_clicks: ≥250 US clicks or 14 calendar days, whichever second
primary.min_qualified: ≥3 sales-ops confirmed employer inquiries (Cheyenne/Holly classify; job seekers never count)

primary.protect_learning: No campaign duplication. No Final URL experiment. No bidding strategy flip.
